svg.aria-label: Featured projects. FITTER-AI — A Telegram bot that estimates calories from a photo of your meal. Okto — A planner for Android, Windows and web with tasks, calendar and a focus timer. Tobi — Monitor Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on Windows 11 and approve actions in one click. TrayMixer — A system tray mixer for per-app volume on Windows 11 and Linux (preview).
